reviews.name: Kathi
reviews.quote: Wir haben kurzlich einen sehr schonen Aufenthalt bei Watikolo genossen. Die ganze Umgebung war ruhig, sauber, und ideal fur einen entspannten Aufenthalt.

reviews.name: Miranda Scott
reviews.quote: This is such a beautiful and incredible place to stay. The staff are all so amazing and welcoming, and the whole venue feels thoughtfully prepared for guests.

reviews.name: I1707KSbenc
reviews.quote: Watikolo was one of the best places we have stayed, not just in the area, but among the places we would gladly recommend for a peaceful and memorable visit.

reviews.name: Ben Coleman
reviews.quote: Watikolo was one of the best places we have stayed, not just in the usual sense of comfort, but in how easy and calm the whole experience felt from start to finish.

reviews.name: Sandra Du
reviews.quote: I have nothing negative to say about our stay. Everything felt clean, organized, and welcoming, and the surroundings made the whole experience more relaxing.

reviews.name: BigBunster
reviews.quote: This is a hidden gem. The atmosphere feels restful, the property gives guests room to breathe, and the whole stay feels more special than a standard booking.

venues.name: Function Hall
venues.shortDescription: A refined ballroom for elegant weddings, galas, and milestone celebrations.
venues.description: The Grand Atrium pairs sweeping chandeliers with flexible floor planning, giving clients a premium setting for luxurious events without sacrificing convenience.

venues.name: Poolside
venues.shortDescription: An open-air venue framed by lush greenery and soft evening lights.
venues.description: Lakeside Pavilion is built for intimate celebrations and romantic ceremonies, with a scenic garden aisle and flexible styling zones.

venues.name: Front
venues.shortDescription: A rooftop venue with city lights, curated cocktails, and sunset-ready views.
venues.description: Skyline Terrace is tailored for stylish evening functions, engagement parties, corporate mixers, and intimate receptions.

venues.name: Crestview Hall
venues.shortDescription: A polished venue for forums, seminars, launches, and company gatherings.
venues.description: Crestview Hall combines business-ready facilities with a warm guest experience, making it ideal for workshops and branded events.

venues.name: Ivory Manor
venues.shortDescription: A boutique private hall designed for intimate milestones and curated gatherings.
venues.description: Ivory Manor offers warm interiors, elegant table layouts, and a private atmosphere perfect for bespoke events and family celebrations.

venues.name: Poolside Garden
venues.location: Purok 4 Upper Puntod Road, Tabalong, Dauis, Bohol
venues.shortDescription: A relaxed poolside garden venue for birthdays, family gatherings, and intimate celebrations.
venues.description: Poolside Garden gives guests a bright outdoor setting beside the pool, with flexible table layouts and easy access to the main house amenities.
